## Links

::: {.entry}
[James Milne's webpage](https://www.jmilne.org/math/)\
It's worth reading everything on his website. Then, spend a few years reading his course notes.
:::

::: {.entry}
[zbMATH](https://zbmath.org/)\
Great resource for finding mathematicians and reviewing their publications.
:::

::: {.entry}
[2swap](https://www.youtube.com/@twoswap/videos)\
One of my favorite mathematical YouTube channels. Completely unparalleled animation quality and sound design.
:::

::: {.entry}
[Gilles Castel](https://castel.dev/)\
Gilles was a legendary liveTeXer with a lecture note workflow 10x more impressive than mine. He has excellent tutorials on his website, alongside all of his sourcecode. He sadly passed away in 2022.
:::

Great TikZ tool for making diagrams and graphs.
